role: Gate: replays ContainersProbe's per-container-kind JSONL through container.c: fill rows set slots and check the slot layout, click rows run one Container.slotClick and compare slots, cursor, returned stack and drops, close rows run onContainerClosed.
notes: Data: out/java/containers/*. Stops a kind after 20 bad rows. Also compares the manifest's per-slot layout strings to the native layout. Which container kinds the manifest lists (e.g. merchant) was not checked. Test code, built only into out/native/test_*; not on the product or GPU path, so no GPU hazards are listed.
